title: Save on shipping costs for lightweight, non-time-sensitive packages with UPS Ground Saver® on EasyPost
summary: EasyPost - Save on shipping costs for lightweight, non-time-sensitive packages with UPS Ground Saver® on EasyPost %
body_markdown:
Access greater UPS savings this peak season. UPS Ground Saver® is an economy ground delivery service, ideal for lightweight, non-time-sensitive packages.


UPS Ground Saver® is designed to offer a premium shipping experience at an economy rate for lightweight shipments. If you ship apparel, accessories, trading cards, or cosmetics, chances are your parcel is light enough to benefit from these new rates.


##


**What is UPS Ground Saver** **®** **?**


[UPS Ground Saver®](https://www.ups.com/us/en/support/shipping-support/shipping-costs-rates/ups-ground-saver) is an economy, ground delivery service. Perfect for your lightweight, non-time-sensitive packages. It allows you to access the reliability of the UPS network at an incredibly competitive price.


### **Coverage area**


UPS Ground Saver® delivers to Alaska, Hawaii, and U.S. Territories. UPS also supports delivery to PO Boxes and APO/FPO/DPO military addresses, granting greater flexibility to reach customers at more destinations without breaking the bank.


### **Service details**


**Delivered By**


Delivered by UPS and/or USPS


**Delivery Days**


Monday – Saturday


**Origins and Pickups**


Within the 48 contiguous United States


**Supported Destinations**


United States, Puerto Rico, U.S. Territories, U.S. Post Office Boxes™, and APO/FPO/DPO addresses


**Tracking**


Package-level tracking available via UPS tracking number


##


**How to get started**


1. Log in or sign up free for EasyPost


2. Navigate to the Carriers tab and activate your UPS account


3. Ship and save on your low value, light weight, non-urgent packages with UPS on EasyPost
